properties.name: jwkt.algorithm
properties.description: JWS algorithm name, such as HS256, RS256 or ES256.

properties.name: jwkt.issuer
properties.description: Default iss claim and, for the parser, the required issuer.

properties.name: jwkt.audience
properties.description: Default aud claims and, for the parser, required audiences.

properties.name: jwkt.secret
properties.description: Raw UTF-8 HMAC secret. Mutually exclusive with secret-base64 and PEM keys.

properties.name: jwkt.secret-base64
properties.description: Base64 or base64url encoded HMAC secret. Mutually exclusive with secret and PEM keys.

properties.name: jwkt.private-key
properties.description: PKCS#8 private key resource (PEM) used for signing.

properties.name: jwkt.public-key
properties.description: X.509 public key resource (PEM) used for verification.

properties.name: jwkt.key-algorithm
properties.description: JCA key algorithm for PEM keys when it cannot be inferred (RSA, EC, Ed25519, ...).

properties.name: jwkt.clock-skew
properties.description: Allowed clock skew when validating exp and nbf.

properties.name: jwkt.expires-in
properties.description: Default lifetime applied to newly issued tokens.

properties.name: jwkt.include-issued-at
properties.description: Whether newly issued tokens receive an iat claim.

properties.name: jwkt.require-expiration
properties.description: Whether parsing rejects tokens without an exp claim.

properties.name: jwkt.headers
properties.description: Additional protected header values applied to newly issued tokens.

properties.name: jwkt.claims
properties.description: Additional claims applied to newly issued tokens.

properties.name: jwkt.required-claims
properties.description: Claim names that must be present during parsing.
